changelog:
Initial public release of manju-artist skill.

- Provides a comprehensive, standardized workflow for comic art direction and AI drawing prompt generation.
- Includes detailed templates and rules for consistent character assets and scene descriptions.
- Defines strict prompt-generation rules to ensure unified art style, composition, and quality across all comic frames.
- Supports popular AI art tools (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, 即梦AI/可灵) with tailored prompt formats and parameters.
- Introduces a quality checklist and maintenance guide to enforce and update visual standards efficiently.
